AliyunUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the cluster
AliyunUid.description_zh: 集群所属的阿里云主账号

CodeState.description_en:
The code execution status. Valid values:

CANCELLED
RUNNING
SUCCEEDED
ERROR
CodeState.description_zh:
代码执行状态，取值如下：
CANCELLED： 执行取消
RUNNING： 执行中
SUCCEEDED： 执行成功
ERROR： 执行失败

CodeType.description_en:
The code type. Valid values:

SCALA
PYTHON
CodeType.description_zh:
代码的类型，取值如下：
SCALA
PYTHON

Columns.description_zh: 当输出结果为表时，表的列名

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the execution. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 执行结束时间的毫秒级时间戳

Output.description_en: The code execution result, which is a JSON string that conforms to Apache Livy
Output.description_zh: 代码执行结果，一个JSON格式的字符串，格式上符合Apache Livy的输出标准

OutputType.description_en:
The execution result type, which is in the JSON format. Valid values:

TEXT: the text content that conforms to Apache Livy.
TABLE: the table content that conforms to Apache Livy
OutputType.description_zh:
执行结果的序列化格式，结构为一个JSON，取值如下：
TEXT： 输出结果为Apache Livy标准下的文本内容。
TABLE：输出结果为Apache Livy标准下的表格内容

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the execution. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 执行开始时间的毫秒级时间戳
